Platform Security

Multi-Layer Protection

Beyond the blockchain, WolvCapital employs enterprise-grade platform security at every layer.

Account Protection

  • Strong password enforcement
  • Optional 2FA via authenticator apps
  • Session & device monitoring
  • Automatic logout on inactivity

Fund Handling

  • On-chain reward pool — visible to everyone
  • Manual withdrawal validation
  • Transparent transaction records
  • 48hr timelock on pool withdrawals

KYC & Anti-Fraud

  • KYC verification required for withdrawals
  • AML compliance monitoring
  • Anomaly detection & human oversight
  • Suspicious activity reporting

Data Security & Privacy

  • 256-bit SSL encryption in transit
  • Encrypted data at rest
  • Restricted internal data access
  • GDPR-aligned privacy policy

Infrastructure

  • Secure cloud hosting
  • Automated daily backups
  • DDoS protection
  • 24/7 uptime monitoring

Transparency Commitment

WolvCapital maintains detailed internal records of all account activity and transactions. All smart contracts are publicly verifiable on BSCScan. If you notice any suspicious activity, contact our security team immediately.
